story_type: pararescue helmet camera, family hoisted off a flooded balcony one by one
hook: A boy stranded by Harvey's floods, seen from his rescuer's helmet.
narration: A pararescueman rode the cable down to this balcony for a boy stranded by Harvey's floods.
This was west Houston, August thirtieth, twenty seventeen, filmed on the helmet of a New York Air National Guard pararescueman.
His HH-60 Pave Hawk hung right above the house.
On a lift like this, the rescuer rides up clipped to the survivor, so even a small child is never alone on the cable.
Once the boy was inside, the rescuer went straight back down.
Next, a woman and a little girl.
Below them, whole streets of west Houston were underwater.
outcome: One at a time, every one of them made it into the helicopter.
title: Family hoisted off a balcony in Harvey
description:
New York Air National Guard pararescuemen from the 106th Rescue Wing rescued families affected by Hurricane Harvey in west Houston on Aug. 30, 2017, using an HH-60 Pave Hawk helicopter, filmed from a helmet camera.
